title: SectionViewStyle group-3 scalar insertion fast slice
scope: Serialize a changed SectionViewStyle group-3 view-label text-style reference and text color when absent from the captured source.
Preserve ordered groups and aligned ASCII raw lexemes/Binary placeholders; bound inserted ACI color to the signed 16-bit DXF range.
Verify typed same-version ASCII and Binary readback without adding repository fixtures or a CTest registration.

implementation.behavior: The copied SectionViewStyle raw carrier inserts group 340 for the view-label text-style handle and group 62 for text color in style group 3 when changed from class defaults and absent in the source. Handle text is checked hexadecimal; zero and sentinel handles are refused. Color is range-checked. The raw writer's existing source-handle remapping applies to group 340.
implementation.generatedControl: The generated style source omits both group-3 fields while retaining the rest of the group. The test confirms initial defaults (handle zero, color 256), edits to the existing VIEW_STYLE_TEXT style and color 34, verifies exact ordered raw groups in ASCII and Binary, and confirms typed readback and reference closure.

limitations: Only same-version generated DXF insertion of these absent single-occurrence fields is covered.
Repeated group-1/group-2 references, colors and hatch-angle cardinality are not changed by this slice; other unsupported shapes remain fail-closed.
No DWG-origin typed output, cross-version translation, native style rendering, or consumer support qualification follows.
